node_or_batch: D-1 operator channel, pre-PHASE-2 successor over b4ca05ac: NB-1 pre-node boundary, NB-2 OEP-1 evidence chain, NB-3 test gaps, PMR-15 measured
protected_surfaces: tests/custody/support/tool-trust-snippet.ts, tests/custody/support/fake-only-mint-tool.ts, tests/custody/support/fake-only-oep1-probe-tool.ts (the source of the certified v3 tools: kept byte-identical so the tools stay the certified bytes)
the pinned v3 tools and the pinned project certificate
protected_authority: every earlier amendment, record and owner decision (append-only)

sentinels.purpose: A NODE_OPTIONS preload (--require, -r, --import) that records its own execution and tries to capture the synthetic operator string from stdin. PRELOAD_EXECUTIONS_BEFORE_GOVERNED_SECRET must be 0 through the governed entry.
The synthetic operator string (.invalid host): captured by nothing but the governed tool.

known_conditions: Node reads NODE_OPTIONS before any user code; a check inside the launcher runs after a preload and is defence in depth only.

The pre-node boundary runs in the operator's shell (Windows PowerShell 5.1; pwsh where available): that shell is the trust root it cannot defend against itself (LD_PRELOAD on the shell, a hostile profile when -NoProfile is omitted).

positive_controls.description: Through the pre-node boundary, with a clean environment: the node binary's sha256 is the plan pin, node starts with the allowlisted environment plus the boundary mark and no execArgv, and the synthetic channel runs to completion.
A digest-bound chain whose FAIL predecessor is superseded by a LATER, recomputed-CLOSED head that acknowledges it closes OEP-1.

PMR-16 holds by measurement: the repository trust root, the rendered trust text's behaviour (pin refused on mismatch, verify-full options on match) and the launcher's CA check (refuses a mismatch in both modes).

negative_controls.description: NODE_OPTIONS=--require=<preload>, -r <preload>, --import=<preload URL> through the boundary: refused before node starts; the preload's execution marker is absent; the sentinel is not captured.
NODE_PATH, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED, OPENSSL_CONF, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR and a lower-case node_options: each alone is refused by the boundary before node starts.
A node binary whose sha256 is not the plan pin is refused before it starts.
Starting the launcher directly (no boundary mark) is refused before the prompt; the control shows that the direct path lets a preload run (the attack is real outside the boundary).

Missing predecessor, predecessor digest mismatch (substitution), a record whose own digest does not match its content, fork, cycle, head observed before a predecessor, a verdict string that its facts do not recompute to, an unacknowledged earlier FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, a candidate identity that is not the certified one, and an evidence path deleted or modified in history: each fails closed.
OT-19: each hostile variable alone, in upper and in lower case, is refused by the rendered trust text (no dependence on another variable, on case, or on a subset of the alternatives).
PROBE_MINT_CONFIGURATION_COHERENT fails for a wrong observed host and for a wrong observed driver digest even when the recorded fingerprint is recomputed to match the wrong observation.
A predecessor without a verdict and without facts is blocking unless the head acknowledges it.
The launcher refuses a missing or mismatching CA before the prompt in MINT mode too.

mutation_controls.description: The boundary's ambient-runtime refusal removed -> R4-N-PRELOAD RED.
The boundary passes the inherited environment to node instead of the allowlist -> R4-P-BOUNDARY / R4-N-PRELOAD RED.
The node sha256 check removed -> R4-N-NODE-PIN RED.
The launcher no longer requires the boundary mark -> R4-N-DIRECT RED.
Predecessor digest not compared -> R4-N-CHAIN RED.
Temporal order not checked -> R4-N-CHAIN RED.
Link verdicts trusted as strings -> R4-N-CHAIN RED.
OT-19 regex without the i flag -> R4-N-O456 RED.
OT-19 PG alternative narrowed -> R4-N-O456 RED.
One OT-19 alternative dropped -> R4-N-O456 RED.
Observed host compared with itself -> R4-N-O1415 RED.
Observed driver digest compared with itself -> R4-N-O1415 RED.
A link without facts recomputes to CLOSED -> R4-N-O11 RED.
The launcher checks the CA in probe mode only -> R4-N-O8 RED.
PMR-16 stops measuring the launcher CA check -> R4-P-PMR16 RED.
A comment-only mutant must survive; kills are attributed only to tests outside the pin block.
